criteria.requirement: Add base_url and url_transform options integrated into real a/img/video/source-fallback/poster conversion. Use urllib.parse.urljoin for nonempty relative destinations with a string base while preserving fragment-only references, empty destinations and absolute URI semantics. Call optional transform(resolved_url, kind) exactly once per actual nonempty destination, with kind link/image/video/poster, after resolution; a None result suppresses that destination and invalid return types raise TypeError. Preserve titles, inline-image rules, autolinks, source ordering and default output. Perform no network requests.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
